data.text: **Access modifiers** control the visibility and accessibility of class members. They are fundamental to encapsulation.

items: private – Accessible only within the class
protected – Accessible within class and derived classes
internal – Accessible within the same assembly
protected internal – Accessible within assembly or derived classes

data.title: Access Modifiers
Key Takeaways
points: Use public for the API surface
data.takeaway: Access modifiers enforce encapsulation and control your API.
